name: copyspeech
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud through CopySpeech, with live word captions and a play button on every reply.

autoRead.title: Read new replies aloud
autoRead.description: Reads each finished reply through CopySpeech.

skipSections.title: Skip bullet points and sections
skipSections.description: Automatic and play-button reads skip headings, list items (with their wrapped lines and nested items), rules, and table rows. Selection reads stay full.

excerpt.title: Read only part of the reply
excerpt.description: Automatic and play-button reads keep the top and bottom paragraphs. Selection reads stay full.

excerptMode.title: Part to read
excerptMode.description: Top paragraphs, bottom paragraphs, or both.

captions.title: Show captions
captions.description: Opens the captions pane by itself when a reading starts. An open pane marks the spoken word.
